changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea el usuario administrador inicial con el correo de la propiedad seed_admin_email (variable SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL) y el rol admin. Sin identity_subject: se enlaza con Keycloak en el primer ingreso, por el correo verificado. Si la propiedad está vacía no crea nada. validCheckSum ANY evita que un cambio posterior de SEED_ADMIN_EMAIL invalide el changeset ya aplicado.
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO users (full_name, email) SELECT 'Administrator', '${seed_admin_email}' WHERE '${seed_admin_email}' <> '' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO user_roles (user_id, role_id) SELECT u.id, r.id FROM users u, roles r WHERE '${seed_admin_email}' <> '' AND lower(u.email) = lower('${seed_admin_email}') AND r.code = 'admin' ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

rollback.sql: DELETE FROM user_roles WHERE '${seed_admin_email}' <> '' AND user_id IN (SELECT id FROM users WHERE lower(email) = lower('${seed_admin_email}'))
DELETE FROM users WHERE '${seed_admin_email}' <> '' AND lower(email) = lower('${seed_admin_email}')
